name: @rbst/raycast-extension
title: Tree Orchestrator
description: Raycast agent for multi-provider chat orchestration, session management, and inference dispatch
author: pv-udpv

commands.name: tree-manager
commands.title: Tree Manager
commands.subtitle: View and manage chat tree
commands.description: Dashboard for tree state, branch status, and quick actions

commands.name: invoke-model
commands.title: Invoke Model
commands.subtitle: Run inference task with cross-provider session
commands.description: Send prompts to Codex, Perplexity, or Claude while preserving conversation context

ai.instructions: You are the Tree Orchestrator AI agent. You can send prompts to multiple inference providers (Codex, Perplexity/pplx-mlx, Claude, and Comet for web-aware queries) and switch between them seamlessly while preserving full conversation context. Comet has live web access and is ideal for current events, real-time data, and web research. Use send-prompt for local/API models, send-to-comet for web-aware answers. Before acting on a prior conversation, always use get-transcript to view history. Switch providers mid-conversation using switch-provider. List available sessions with list-sessions.

tools.name: send-prompt
tools.title: Send Prompt
tools.description: Send a prompt to a provider (codex, pplx-mlx, claude, or comet). Creates a new session if sessionId is not provided.

tools.name: send-to-comet
tools.title: Send to Comet
tools.description: Send a web-aware question to Perplexity Comet. Comet has live browser access and can fetch current web context, real-time data, and research.

tools.name: switch-provider
tools.title: Switch Provider
tools.description: Switch to a different provider mid-conversation. Preserves full conversation context across provider boundaries.

tools.name: list-sessions
tools.title: List Sessions
tools.description: List all available conversation sessions with their metadata (creation time, turn count, active providers).

tools.name: get-transcript
tools.title: Get Transcript
tools.description: Retrieve the full conversation transcript for a session, including all turns and provider tags.
